contract: OME 4.1 REST (OData v4), verified against OME 3.x/4.x public evidence

appliance_info.description: Appliance identity and version (used by test_connection).

appliance_network.description: Current appliance network address configuration (read-only view of the management interface).

Ipv4Configuration.description: IPv4 settings: Enable, EnableDHCP, StaticIPAddress, StaticSubnetMask, StaticGateway, DNS servers.

devices.description: All devices managed or monitored by the appliance (servers, chassis, network and storage IOMs).

Id.description: OME device identifier; parent key for inventory, power, temperature, logs.

Type.description: Device type id: 1000 SERVER, 2000 CHASSIS, 3000 STORAGE, 4000 NETWORK_IOM, 8000 STORAGE_IOM, 9000 NETWORK_CONTROLLER (see device_types).

Identifier.description: Service tag or other unique identifier.

ChassisServiceTag.description: Service tag of the enclosing chassis (modular sleds).

PowerState.description: Power state id: 17 ON, 18 OFF, 20 POWERING_ON, 21 POWERING_OFF (OME convention).

ManagedState.description: Managed state id (3000 managed, 2000 unmanaged/monitored, 1000 unknown).

Status.description: Rollup health: 1000 NORMAL, 2000 UNKNOWN, 3000 WARNING, 4000 CRITICAL, 5000 NO_STATUS.

ConnectionState.description: True when OME can currently reach the device management endpoint.

SystemId.description: Dell system id of the platform.

DeviceName.description: Display name (usually the iDRAC DNS name or host name).

LastInventoryTime.description: Appliance timestamp text of the last inventory collection.

LastStatusTime.description: Appliance timestamp text of the last health status update.

DeviceCapabilities.description: Numeric capability ids reported by the device.

DeviceManagement.description: Management endpoints: ManagementId, NetworkAddress, MacAddress, ManagementType, InstrumentationName, DnsName, ManagementProfile[].

SlotConfiguration.description: Chassis slot placement for modular devices.

device_types.description: Device type id to name mapping.

Name.description: Type name, e.g. SERVER, CHASSIS, NETWORK_IOM.

device_inventory.description: Detailed inventory of one device, one row per inventory item (processor, memory module, NIC, firmware component...). Supply parent DeviceId; add parent InventoryType (e.g. serverProcessors, serverMemoryDevices, deviceSoftware, serverNetworkInterfaces, serverPowerSupplies, serverArrayDisks) to fetch a single inventory type.

InventoryItem.description: One inventory item; keys differ per InventoryType (e.g. ModelName, Status, SerialNumber).

device_hardware_logs.description: Hardware (Lifecycle/SEL) log entries of one device.

LogSeverity.description: Severity id (OME severity vocabulary: 2 INFO, 4 NORMAL, 8 WARNING, 16 CRITICAL).

device_power.description: Current power telemetry of one device (iDRAC power monitoring).

device_temperature.description: Inlet temperature telemetry of one device.

systemUpTime.description: Uptime text as reported by the device.

alerts.description: Alert log. Filter by SeverityType (16 critical, 8 warning), StatusType, CategoryId, AlertDeviceId or TimeStamp; order with TimeStamp desc; use lookback for a recent window.

SeverityType.description: Severity id: 1 UNKNOWN, 2 INFO, 4 NORMAL, 8 WARNING, 16 CRITICAL.

AlertDeviceGroupName.description: Group name associated with the alert when present.

TimeStamp.description: Appliance timestamp text of the alert.

CategoryId.description: Category id: 1 SYSTEM_HEALTH, 2 STORAGE, 3 UPDATES, 4 AUDIT, 5 CONFIGURATION, 6 WORK_NOTES, 7 MISCELLANEOUS.

alert_categories.description: Alert catalogs and their categories (one row per catalog/category pair) with sub-category details.

Name.description: Catalog name, e.g. iDRAC, Application, Networking.

warranties.description: Warranty entitlements per device (one row per entitlement line). Date comparison in $filter is not supported; compute expiry in pandas from EndDate/DaysRemaining.

ServiceLevelDescription.description: Service level description, e.g. ProSupport Plus.

DaysRemaining.description: Days remaining (negative or zero once expired).

firmware_baselines.description: Firmware baselines with their compliance summary. Parent key for firmware_compliance_reports.

RepositoryType.description: Repository type: DELL_ONLINE, HTTPS, CIFS, NFS...

TaskId.description: Compliance check job id (join to jobs.Id).

TaskStatusId.description: Compliance job status id (2060 Completed, 2070 Failed...).

Targets.description: Baseline targets: Id, Type{Id,Name} (1000 DEVICE, 6000 GROUP).

firmware_compliance_reports.description: Firmware compliance of every device in a baseline, flattened to one row per component report (devices without component reports keep one row with empty Component.* columns).

RebootRequired.description: Device needs a reboot for the updates.

firmware_catalogs.description: Firmware catalogs (repository definitions) used by baselines.

jobs.description: Appliance jobs (inventory, discovery, firmware update, compliance...). $orderby is not supported by OME; sort in pandas. Parent key for job_execution_histories.

Id.description: Job identifier; parent key for job_execution_histories.

LastRunStatus.Id.description: Last run status id: 2020 Scheduled, 2030 Queued, 2040 Starting, 2050 Running, 2060 Completed, 2070 Failed, 2080 New, 2090 Warning, 2100 Aborted, 2101 Paused, 2102 Stopped, 2103 Canceled.

JobType.Id.description: Job type id (e.g. 8 Inventory_Task, 101 Discovery_Task, 5 Update_Task).

JobStatus.Id.description: Current status id (same vocabulary as LastRunStatus).

Params.description: Job parameters as Key/Value pairs; secret-like keys are removed.

Id.description: Execution history id; parent key for job_execution_details.

JobStatus.Id.description: Run status id (2060 Completed, 2070 Failed, 2090 Warning...).

job_execution_details.description: Per-target detail of one job run, including the full output text (Value) that explains failures.

IdBaseEntity.description: Target entity id (device id when applicable).

Value.description: Output text of the run for this target.

groups.description: Static and query device groups (built-in and user defined).

Id.description: Group id; parent key for group_devices.

GlobalStatus.description: Rollup health of member devices (same vocabulary as devices.Status).

TypeId.description: Group type id: 1000 internal, 2000 built-in system, 3000 user-defined.

group_devices.description: Direct member devices of one group (device records).

ChassisServiceTag.description: Service tag of the enclosing chassis (modular sleds).

PowerState.description: Power state id: 17 ON, 18 OFF, 20 POWERING_ON, 21 POWERING_OFF (OME convention).

Status.description: Rollup health: 1000 NORMAL, 2000 UNKNOWN, 3000 WARNING, 4000 CRITICAL, 5000 NO_STATUS.

ConnectionState.description: True when OME can currently reach the device management endpoint.

LastStatusTime.description: Appliance timestamp text of the last health status update.

DeviceCapabilities.description: Numeric capability ids reported by the device.

DeviceManagement.description: Management endpoints: ManagementId, NetworkAddress, MacAddress, ManagementType, InstrumentationName, DnsName, ManagementProfile[].

SlotConfiguration.description: Chassis slot placement for modular devices.

group_all_leaf_devices.description: All devices under one group including sub-groups (device records).

management_domains.description: Multi-chassis management (MCM) domains known to the appliance. Standalone OME appliances typically return no rows.
